method: Read-only current source/assertion inspection and retained passing XML/real-browser/source records. No execution, checkout/ledger mutation or promotion; counts never substitute for predicate-specific proof.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-01 — serviço de projeção.** Compor consultas em lote sobre aprovações, perguntas, handoffs, receipts, recuperação e entregas. Retornar referências, não duplicar payloads secretos. Reutilizar serviços/ports quando disponíveis; evitar N+1 e consultas sem limite.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-02 — armazenamento auxiliar.** Persistir somente seen/snooze e, se indispensável, uma projeção materializada reconstruível com referências de origem. Não criar uma nova fila de handoffs ou aprovações. Modelar a preferência sob o principal de operador já existente; não adicionar usuários/agentes apenas para suportar o painel. Em uma instalação de operador único, documentar esse escopo compartilhado entre dispositivos.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-03 — transações e leitura.** GET não materializa decisões nem altera lifecycle. Atualizações de projeção devem ocorrer após confirmação do fato original ou em manutenção limitada. Auditoria/autenticação já existente continua separada; não alterar seus contratos sob pretexto de leitura pura.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-04 — API.** Propor `GET /api/v1/attention`, `GET /api/v1/attention/summary` e ações explícitas de visto/adiado. Usar envelope, autenticação de operador e controles de origem do produto. Os nomes podem ser adequados na implementação; seus contratos devem permanecer únicos e versionados.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-05 — SSE e reconciliação da visão.** Reutilizar o canal SSE como notificação de invalidação; ler a projeção canônica em resposta. Reunir rajadas, não buscar todos os dados a cada token. Se um fato relevante não gerar evento, acrescentar um evento mínimo após commit ou usar refresh limitado da visão; não criar um monitor por agente.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-06 — UI integrada.** Adicionar item ao menu e badge global. Preservar Graph, Meta-harness e páginas especializadas. Mostrar agente, contexto, motivo, idade, origem/atualidade e ação principal. Permitir abrir a sessão ou o registro original sem navegar por várias telas.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-07 — interação segura.** Visto não resolve. Adiado não aprova nem suspende a execução. Aprovar mantém confirmação e fencing atuais. Resultado desconhecido oferece inspeção; nunca um botão “repetir tudo”. Ações sobre fatos que mudaram exibem conflito e recarregam a situação.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **ATN-08 — acessibilidade.** Navegação por teclado, foco previsível, textos que não dependem de cor, estados vazios distintos de erro e light/dark conforme o dashboard. A abertura da página não deve mostrar toasts repetidos de todo o histórico.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-01 — vínculo explícito.** Registrar uma fonte de atividade para uma identidade existente e workspace aprovado. Não associar agente pela igualdade de nome, hostname, diretório ou pane. Exigir seleção explícita e autenticação/consentimento compatível.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-02 — capacidade restrita.** Reutilizar a infraestrutura de credenciais escopadas quando apropriado, sem ampliar os EPTs de leitura existentes. Caso seja necessária uma nova família de token, ela deve ser opaca, revogável, armazenada com proteção/hash apropriado, de curta duração e aceita exclusivamente nos endpoints de telemetria previstos.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-03 — ordenação e replay.** Aceitar sequência monotônica por fonte/instância/generation. Mesma sequência e mesmo hash é idempotente, não emite outro evento nem renova validade. Mesmo número com conteúdo diferente conflita. Sequência antiga não sobrescreve o estado atual. Geração antiga não altera a nova.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-04 — freshness.** Usar horário de recebimento do Server e idade/horário observado com tolerância de relógio documentada. Reporte excessivamente antigo não vira estado atual apenas porque chegou agora. Relógio futuro não cria validade ilimitada. Após reconnect, buscar snapshot novo da fonte e publicar estado atual; não reproduzir backlog como se fosse observação recente.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-05 — empacotamento opcional.** Implementar um módulo opcional invocado, por exemplo, por `okto-nexus observe herdr`. Ele roda perto da instância Herdr e publica via HTTP autenticado no Nexus. Não exige o daemon Connector, não registra executor e não inicia junto com o Server por padrão.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-06 — contrato real instalado.** Usar a CLI/socket API documentada. Registrar versão e obter o schema da instalação quando suportado (`herdr api schema --json`). A documentação pública não basta para presumir campos da versão instalada. Criar fixtures a partir do contrato compatível, sem dados pessoais. [H01]
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-07 — identidade do ocupante.** Mapear instalação/sessão Herdr + pane + identidade/generation do ocupante para instância observada. Nome é só alias. Fechar, mover, renomear pane ou substituir processo não pode transferir silenciosamente o vínculo ao novo agente.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-08 — leitura sem controle.** A integração consulta/lista/assina; não chama `agent.start`, `agent.prompt`, `send-keys`, focus, aprovação ou kill. Seu token Nexus também não pode executar essas ações. Um plugin Herdr roda com permissões do usuário: documentar essa fronteira; token restrito no Nexus não é sandbox de código local. [H03]
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-09 — semântica de término.** Usar `completion_seq` ou referência equivalente somente quando disponível e coerente com o schema. Sem prova de nova conclusão, mostrar idle, não produzir uma entrega “concluída”. `agent.wait` do Herdr observa atividade, não a conclusão de um handoff específico; não usá-lo como verificador de tarefas Nexus. [H02]
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-10 — exemplo mínimo.** Documentar registro autorizado, obtenção de capacidade, publicação, sequência, TTL, revogação e encerramento. Oferecer helper pequeno, isolado e testado. Não exigir plugin framework ou implementação de `LocalRuntimeCore`.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-11 — projeção.** Acrescentar `external_blocked`, `external_completion_unseen` e `external_observation_stale` à central, com origem, atualidade e limitação explícitas. Fonte externa bloqueada sem pedido canônico não recebe botão “aprovar”; a ação é inspecionar no ambiente de origem.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

rows.requirement_exact: **OBS-12 — fontes concorrentes.** Para uma mesma instância explicitamente correlacionada, manter precedência/proveniência definida: fatos canônicos do Core não são sobrescritos por inferência de terminal. Divergência pode aparecer como diagnóstico, sem alterar autorização. Fontes sem correlação suficiente permanecem separadas.
rows.recommendation: VERIFIED for the declared implemented Windows contract; attach these exact references, without changing global R3/M1/M2 acceptance.

projection.behavior: Closed metadata-only canonical predicates combine native requests, verification, unknown/recovery, authority, aged handoffs, results and cleanup in one bounded relation; no payload hydration or per-item graph query.
projection.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

preferences.behavior: Auxiliary seen/snooze belong to the existing shared operator principal; exact CAS and transactional anchors preserve episodes without touching canonical rows.
preferences.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

passive.behavior: GET/snapshot and preferences preserve canonical rows; source commits and rollback create auxiliary metadata atomically while existing authentication remains separate.
passive.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

api.behavior: Operator API has versioned envelopes, exact filters, stable cursor ties and same-relation page/count authorization; preferences retain source and preference CAS.
api.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

stream.behavior: SSE metadata invalidates bounded snapshots; gaps/reconnect/time deadlines refresh, transient errors retain stale data and current authorization loss clears protected content.
frontend_tests: reset and retention gaps request snapshots without exposing historical notifications
network failures retain last authorized page and badge without false zeros
authorization loss,403 and featureoff clear authorized data and timers
refresh deadline includes request elapsed time and wake rechecks immediately
stream.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

ui.behavior: Menu/badge and grouped view preserve existing pages and resolve exact source records through shared canonical inspection and decision controls.
frontend_tests: all thirteen actions resolve exact existing canonical records
opening every target only invokes canonical inspection methods, including cleanup inspect
hidden page keeps an independent workspace badge and a bounded timer
ui.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

interaction.behavior: Viewing state is not resolution; stale command revisions conflict, unknown outcomes offer inspection, and lost preference replies reconcile via reads without replay.
frontend_tests: generic decisions send the reviewed revision and never retry a conflict
mutation409 refreshes CAS and a stale click is never sent
lost mutation response reconciles with reads and never resubmits the preference
interaction.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

accessible.behavior: Accessible grouping, explicit labels/status, keyboard focus restoration, light/dark/narrow layout and escaped untrusted text are observed in actual browser plus semantic/unit checks.
frontend_tests: focus stays on its record or moves to the next surviving row, then the previous row or heading
source names are plain known labels, including prototype-like unknown values
accessible.limit: Actual browser keyboard/focus/semantic accessibility and themes were checked; no named screen-reader product campaign is claimed or required by the literal implementation task.

native_authority.behavior: Request recipient and present canonical authority determine action; expired requests retain historical inspection and do not become operator-answerable when directed to an agent.
native_authority.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

canonical_states.behavior: Normal CLAIMED/silence or dependency waiting is not an incident; verifier authorization and actual current unknown/cleanup facts determine action, keeping successful results successful.
canonical_states.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

temporal.behavior: Threshold and TTL changes use explicit time policy without writing lifecycle or generating a new episode on refresh.
temporal.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

registration.behavior: Explicit existing agent and workspace selection creates only auxiliary sources/instances; strict payload rejects caller-supplied identity and server owns generation.
registration.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

audience.behavior: Opaque hashed short-lived observation credentials authorize only literal activity publication. Current source/agent/workspace/generation and explicit permissions are checked before replay; management/reissue use canonical credentials.
audience.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

replay.behavior: Sequence/hash and source/instance generation fences are durable; exact replay returns original receipt without TTL renewal/event, conflicts roll back and reset does not reuse fences.
replay.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

freshness.behavior: Receipt and observed age bound validity; future/backlog refusal and temporal expiry yield stale/unknown, never canonical idle, free capacity or refreshed MCP presence.
frontend_tests: only current observations display reported activity; stale never becomes idle
freshness.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

limits.behavior: Strict bounded report/batch/text/instance/token/cardinality and durable aggregate rates plus bounded retention provide honest backpressure; storage/commit refusal never acknowledges unpersisted data.
limits.limit: Fault injection covers the honest no-ack/rollback contract. It does not claim physically filling the host disk; no destructive disk-fill campaign is necessary for this literal behavior.

optional.behavior: Observer is an explicit optional CLI/helper command; Server bootstrap and canonical routes have no Herdr execution prerequisite or Connector executor registration side effect.
optional.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

herdr_contract.behavior: Explicit installed version/schema hash plus live status are validated; bounded degraded polling takes a fresh snapshot after reconnect and incompatible shapes are explicit unavailability.
herdr_contract.limit: Qualified Windows Herdr0.9.5/protocol22/schema1 with synthetic observed occupants. Polling is declared degraded; no invented subscription cursor, productive provider or other platform qualification.

occupant.behavior: Installation/session/pane plus host-owned process birth/image identity form the binding; names/paths are aliases and move/replacement/PID reuse require reassociation.
occupant.limit: Windows local birth/occupant contract; unknown/replaced evidence refuses. No inference of identity from names, paths or bare PID; no added remote/other-OS requirement.

observer_readonly.behavior: Fixed Herdr command allowlist reads version/schema/status/snapshot/process-info only, no shell/terminal content or control commands; local user-code permission is not a Nexus-token sandbox.
observer_readonly.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

completion.behavior: Initial done/switch/idle without a new coherent counter has no completion; retained completion ref is observational and stable, never a task verifier or productive command.
completion.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

helper.behavior: Small separate HTTP publisher plus example document registration/token/sequence/TTL/revoke/exit; token is confined to exact endpoint and retries preserve uncertainty/explicit intent.
helper.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

external.behavior: Three stable external occurrences are inspection-only; current/stale/history and per-agent/per-instance aggregation remain explicitly observational, independent of presence/capacity.
frontend_tests: external attention exposes inspection only and preserves observational wording
complete aggregate retains mixed instances and unavailable evidence separately
external.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

canonical_isolation.behavior: Publication/seen cannot create authority, reservations, work or task success; only correlated canonical terminal event can settle the current turn and admit execution of queued work.
frontend_tests: external reports never resolve canonical approval, execution or task controls
a correlated external occurrence still has no approve, dispatch or canonical navigation authority
canonical_isolation.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

correlation.behavior: Operator-selected/fenced native evidence produces minimum passive Core facts with provenance ahead of separate external signal; unrelated/stale sources remain uncorrelated and historical completion cannot inherit a later selection.
frontend_tests: canonical facts precede the external signal, including compact instance rows
received terminal stages never infer idle activity or current execution state

untrusted.behavior: Closed schema and bounded text reject identity/secret/command fields; source values are escaped literal UI data without active links/HTML; errors do not echo input.
frontend_tests: canonical and external identifiers remain escaped plaintext without command links
untrusted.limit: No missing literal implementation/assertion identified in the reviewed Windows contract; no real provider campaign is needed for this behavior.

off.behavior: Explicit OBS true-to-false toggle leaves canonical Core local queue/control working. Current mixed MCP-only/runtime and actual HTTP/WSS Connector cases use bootstrap({}, isolatedhome) with default feature_observations=false and prove canonical cooperation/delivery.
off.limit: Direct toggle proof is local Core; complementary remote/MCP proofs run OBS-off from initial configuration. Scope is canonical Windows with explicit synthetic native peers, not provider/service qualification. No additional real-provider prerequisite for literal OB24.
